cases.title: The dev database is dumped read-only and restored into two identical e2e copies
cases.steps: docker exec gene-invoice-db pg_dump -U geneinvoice geneinvoice > data/dev.sql; restore (owner lines stripped) into e2e_migration and e2e_migration_base; compare row counts with the dump
cases.expected: dump non-empty; both copies hold exactly the dump's rows (customers, invoices, payments, ...)
cases.evidence: dump 5602382 bytes, 30 tables; regions table in dump: false

cases.title: The new jar still starts on the h2 profile (in-memory) with the default region and admin grant
cases.steps: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=h2 java -jar dist/backend.jar on :18108; POST /api/auth/login admin/admin123; GET /api/regions; GET /api/history/range; grep log
cases.expected: Started; no ERROR log line and no DDL failure; regions = [DEFAULT (default, active)]; admin /me regions = DEFAULT APPROVE/ALL; history range 200

cases.title: On h2 a save and a rule work (new tables created cleanly, outbox accepts events)
cases.steps: on the h2 backend: POST /api/customers {name, username, password} (no regionId: single region); POST /api/automation/rules (MANUAL CUSTOMER rule, CREATE_TASK); count automation_events via GET /api/automation/health
cases.expected: customer 200 with regionCode DEFAULT; rule 200

cases.title: With the default halt_on_error the new jar fails on the dev DB exactly where the baseline jar fails (no new schema error)
cases.steps: boot BASELINE jar on e2e_migration_base and the NEW jar on e2e_migration, both with SCHEMA_HALT_ON_ERROR unset (true); collect the halting DDL
cases.expected: Scope: "startup succeeds with no schema errors". The new jar must not introduce a schema error of its own; any failure must be one the baseline has too
cases.actual: {"baselineStarted":false,"newStarted":false,"baselineHalt":"alter table if exists email_recipients add column field varchar(4) not null check (field in ('TO','CC')) => ERROR: column \"field\" of relation \"email_recipients\" contains null values","newHalt":"alter table if exists email_recipients add column field varchar(4) not null check (field in ('TO','CC')) => ERROR: column \"field\" of relation \"email_recipients\" contains null values"}
cases.evidence: docs/regression/2026-09-28/scripts/runtime/migration/baseline-halt.log / docs/regression/2026-09-28/scripts/runtime/migration/new-halt.log: "Halting on error"; pre-existing drift of the dev DB (email tables from another branch) also stops the baseline

cases.title: A representative dataset is created through the BASELINE jar on a fresh database (clean pre-upgrade install)
cases.steps: create e2e_migration_seed; boot baseline jar (halt_on_error default) on :18108; seed through its API: 7 staff (every role, 1 inactive), 3 products, 10 customers with logins/POCs, 40 back-dated invoices (2 cancelled), 15 payments, 5 promises, 3 disputes (1 denied); snapshot what each user sees; stop; clone to e2e_migration_seedup
cases.expected: baseline starts with no DDL failure; every seed call succeeds

cases.title: New jar starts on the existing data with no schema error of its own (halt_on_error=true)
cases.steps: boot dist/backend.jar (profile dev) on e2e_migration_seedup; grep backend-seedup.log for ERROR lines, DDL failures, app WARNs
cases.expected: Started; no log line at ERROR level; DDL failures = none; no WARN from the upgrade beans / history baseline

cases.title: Exactly one region exists after the upgrade: DEFAULT, default and active, guarded by the partial unique index

cases.expected: DESIGN §3.11 step 1: one row code DEFAULT, is_default, active; uk_regions_default exists; API lists it

cases.title: Every existing customer, invoice, payment, promise and dispute got a region (the default), region_id is NOT NULL, children match their customer

cases.expected: B1 "every record belongs to exactly one": 0 nulls; is_nullable NO on all five; 0 mismatches; all rows in DEFAULT; row counts unchanged by the upgrade

cases.title: Nothing references a missing region: every region_id column in the schema points at an existing region

cases.expected: 0 orphan rows in every table with a region_id (live, version, tasks, pending changes, thresholds, notifications, audit...); FKs on the five regional tables
